name: Great Weapon Fighting
summary: A fighting style feat that treats 1s and 2s on two-handed melee damage dice as 3s.

stats.text: When you roll damage for an attack you make with a Melee weapon that you are holding with two hands, you can treat any 1 or 2 on a damage die as a 3. The weapon must have the Two-Handed or Versatile property to gain this benefit.
